title: pretty DIONE|Fashion Plus Size V Neck Mermaid Sequin & Tulle Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Want to look like a princess from a fairy tale? If yes, then this plus size dress would surely make you look like one. It has a fishtail silhouette and beautiful ruffles sleeves. This dress features a plunging v-neckline and a belt for the waistline. Wear this dress and make every woman jealous. We think this gorgeous evening dress is perfect for all formal occasions, from evening party, cocktail, weddings to prom, homecoming and graduation!


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.


Closure: It is concealed Zipper up the Back.


Undergarments: It is Not Padded, without Lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is No Stretch.
